searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Queries to run on Google Maps. Examples: "coffee shops in Austin", "dentist 78704", "plumbers near Miami".

startUrls.title: Direct place URLs
startUrls.description: Direct Google Maps place URLs to scrape without running a search. Example: https://www.google.com/maps/place/.../@...

language.title: Language code
language.description: Google Maps UI language. Affects review translation and address format.

maxPlacesPerQuery.title: Max places per query
maxPlacesPerQuery.description: Cap on places returned per search query.

maxPlacesTotal.title: Max places per run
maxPlacesTotal.description: Hard cap on places extracted per run. Controls total cost.

scrapeReviews.title: Scrape reviews
scrapeReviews.description: Open each place and scroll the reviews panel.

maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Max reviews per place
maxReviewsPerPlace.description: Reviews per place cap. 0 skips reviews.

scrapeImages.title: Scrape images
scrapeImages.description: Extract image URLs from each place.

enrichFromWebsite.title: Enrich from business website
enrichFromWebsite.description: Visit the business website and pull emails and person names with job titles. Adds 5 to 10 seconds per place.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip place IDs pushed on previous runs. Turn off to track changes.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential strongly recommended. Google blocks datacenter IPs.
